about: The fixed scenes of the picture comparison (docs/openfallout/picture-comparison.md). A place is a start cell (an editor id, or a worldspace and a grid cell) and positions in game units; a weather is a form id of the game's master with its editor id. Angles are degrees: yaw 0 looks north, 90 east; pitch is positive down.

scenes.name: nv-interior
scenes.for: An interior: the lamps of a room, furniture and the textures of walls and floor. The place of the measurement scene nv-interior.

scenes.name: nv-exterior
scenes.for: The open desert by day: land, rocks, plants and the sky. The place of the measurement scene nv-exterior.

scenes.name: nv-busy
scenes.for: A busy exterior: houses, a store, a truck, poles and hills along a road near the start point (no character is in view). The place of the measurement scene nv-busy.

scenes.name: fo3-interior
scenes.for: An interior: the metal rooms and lights of a vault. The place of the measurement scene fo3-interior.

scenes.name: fo3-exterior
scenes.for: The open wasteland by day: land, rocks, bushes, power pylons and the sky. The place of the measurement scene fo3-exterior.

scenes.name: fo3-busy
scenes.for: A busy exterior: a town of many structures, objects and characters. The place of the measurement scene fo3-busy.

scenes.name: nv-shadows
scenes.for: Shadows: a low afternoon sun behind a windmill, plants and rocks, whose long shadows fall towards the camera, with every kind of shadow on.

scenes.name: fo3-shadows
scenes.for: Shadows: a low afternoon sun on the structures of a town, whose hard shadow edge falls on the ground close by, with every kind of shadow on.

scenes.name: nv-water
scenes.for: Water with the water shader, reflection and refraction: the lake of grid cell 13,12 (water level 2600, land under water in the whole cell), the camera 250 units above it looking west to the shore of cell 12,12.

scenes.name: fo3-water
scenes.for: Water with the water shader, reflection and refraction: the river of grid cell 20,-17 (water level 10500, land under water in the whole cell), the camera 250 units above it looking north, away from the ship of cell 20,-18 (RivetCityExterior07).

scenes.name: nv-post
scenes.for: Post-processing: the bloom and adjustment shaders of the engine over a bright desert and sky (the place of nv-exterior).

scenes.name: fo3-post
scenes.for: Post-processing: the bloom and adjustment shaders of the engine over land, pylons and sky (the place of fo3-exterior).
